name: com.xlx.speech.voicereadsdk.ui.activity.SpeechVoiceReadPaperGuideFailureActivity
description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when the user closes the guide or leaves the reading task before finishing. It offers a choice to continue the reading task or exit.
disableEffect: Users will no longer be able to return to this unfinished reading task through its recovery prompt.
